items.title: At least 28 killed, 25 critically injured after fire engulfs Bangkok bar
items.description: Firefighters arrived at the scene in the Chatuchak district to find patrons running through flames to escape.

items.title: 'Hero, legend, sweetheart': Tributes to Jurassic Park actor Sam Neill, who has died aged 78
items.description: Friends, politicians and fellow film stars remember Neill following his "sudden and unexpected" death.

items.title: Senator Lindsey Graham died of aortic tear, examiner says
items.description: Graham, a close Republican ally of Donald Trump, died at the age of 71 on Saturday evening.

items.title: Wildfire raging south of Paris could have been set deliberately, says minister
items.description: It was the first time firefighting planes had been sent up from the normally drier and hotter south of the country to tackle fires in the Paris region.

items.title: Men disguised as police kill Ecuadorean drug lord's brother
items.description: The victim, David Macías, was the brother of drug lord 'El Fito', who is awaiting trial in the US.

items.title: Infantino opens door to 64-team World Cup
items.description: Plans for a 64-team men's world cup are set to be picked up and assessed in detail after the 2026 tournament with Fifa boss Gianni Infantino saying football needs to be "for the whole world".

items.title: German court convicts Iraqi couple of enslaving Yazidi girls
items.description: The pair, named only as Twana H.S. and Asia R. A., left Germany for Iraq in 2015 and became members of the Islamic State group.
